d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is globally expanding its Embedded Devices Software Solution Sales team, hiring managers, directors, and account managers to broaden reach in mission-critical industries. The successful candidates will focus on our Ubuntu product portfolio, which is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer offering, Ubuntu Core for IoT, provides state-of-the-art security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment, serving global brands in consumer, industrial electronics, automotive, and robotics. We are continually enhancing this portfolio with features like real-time Linux capability and pursuing various certifications, representing Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint. We seek technically skilled professionals familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS.

This is a high-energy role focused on prospecting sales and strategic account development, demanding ambition and focus. You will be responsible for carrying an annual bookings quota and must be comfortable positioning and selling a range of open source, services, and software solutions. Leveraging Ubuntu's market adoption, the work requires actively building trusted and profitable commercial relationships, developing the potential of your territory beyond managing inbound interest. This involves prospecting new business, maintaining existing relationships, and working with colleagues on account strategy. Candidates must be effective in selling complex technical solutions, including enterprise software, cloud, virtualization, and container technologies, to senior levels of the enterprise and departments focused on embedded software and IoT devices. Professional practice, clear account planning, continuous pipeline reporting, and the ability to travel regionally for client engagement and internationally for company events twice a year are expected.
Location: We are growing our sales reach with remote roles in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas; and office based roles in Taipei, Taiwan.
Building and executing a territory sales plan to prioritize leading security-focused brands and manufacturers
Working with marketing to promote our brand and increase market awareness in prioritized accounts
Developing pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
Closing contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets and achieve strategic objectives
Managing customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
Working with Field Engineers to understand customer requirements and ensure customer satisfaction
Maintaining accurate data and forecasts within Salesforce
Establishing productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision-makers
Coordinating with colleagues, including support, delivery, and management
q: Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

d: Designfit is a design and interior fit-out company coordinating design, procurement, and project delivery for commercial spaces. Working in the construction sector, the company delivers commercial interiors through close collaboration across design, supply, and site execution teams.

This Project Manager role is central to the successful delivery of interior fit-out projects, bringing structure, oversight, and momentum across the full project lifecycle. You will work closely with clients and project stakeholders to keep delivery aligned with project goals, quality expectations, timelines, and budgets.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field.
A Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field is considered an advantage.
PMP, LEED, or NEBOSH certification is considered an advantage.
10–15 years of relevant interior fit-out experience, including at least three years in project management overseeing complete project lifecycles.
Experience delivering high-end commercial, retail, food and beverage, hospitality, or corporate office projects on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional project teams, coordinate with clients, consultants, and subcontractors, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Local authority regulations and approval processes, including DM, DCD, and Trakhees
Experience working on projects in the UAE and familiarity with regional construction practices are highly preferred.
r: Lead and manage all phases of the interior fit-out project lifecycle, including design coordination, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and final handover.
Develop detailed project programs and deliver milestones on schedule and within budget.
Coordinate clients, consultants, designers, suppliers, and subcontractors around project goals.
Review drawings, specifications, material submittals, and method statements.
Conduct site inspections to monitor progress, quality, and health and safety compliance.
Manage procurement schedules and delivery of long-lead items.
Prepare project reports, meeting minutes, and progress documentation.
Track cost control, change orders, cash flow forecasts, and other project financials.
Lead snagging and handover with relevant stakeholders.
Undertake other duties assigned by management in line with organizational needs.

d: Company Description Gulf Resources Trd. & Cont. Co. is a leading provider of value-added distribution solutions in Kuwait, serving a wide range of wholesale clients and industries. The company focuses on delivering reliable, efficient, and tailored distribution services that support business growth and operational excellence. With a strong presence in the local market, Gulf Resources emphasizes long-term partnerships, quality service, and responsive customer support. Team members benefit from working in a dynamic commercial environment where continuous improvement and professional development are encouraged.

Role Description The Wholesale Supervisor is a full-time, on-site role based in Al Asimah, Kuwait, responsible for overseeing day-to-day wholesale operations and ensuring smooth distribution activities. This role includes supervising sales and warehouse teams, monitoring order processing, managing inventory levels, and coordinating deliveries to wholesale customers. The supervisor will track sales performance, prepare operational reports, support business planning initiatives, and implement process improvements to increase efficiency and profitability. Daily responsibilities also include handling key customer accounts, resolving service issues, collaborating with management on pricing and promotional strategies, and ensuring compliance with company policies and safety standards.
q: Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret sales data, monitor KPIs, and make data-driven operational decisions.
Candidates should possess Business Planning skills to support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic initiatives in wholesale distribution.
Candidates should possess clear and effective Communication skills to coordinate with internal teams, suppliers, and wholesale customers.
Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client relationships, address concerns, and maintain high satisfaction levels.
Candidates should possess Sales Operations skills to oversee order processing, inventory control, and day-to-day sales activities.
Relevant experience in wholesale, FMCG, or distribution operations, preferably in a supervisory or team lead role.
Strong leadership and people management abilities, with experience coaching and developing team members.
Proficiency in basic office software (e.g., Excel, ERP or inventory systems) and comfort working with operational reports.
Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field is preferred.
Ability to work on-site in Al Asimah, Kuwait
